name: 108, Emergency Ambulance Service - Uttarakhand
benefit: - In any type of medical emergency, patients are transported to the hospital and provided with first aid facilities. - The benefits of this service are being provided to the residents of the state through 272 ambulances.
_eligibility_text: 1. The beneficiary must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The benefit is provided to accident victims and individuals requiring emergency services.
